description.value:
Perhaps you're the seventh child of a seventh child, were born under an auspicious moon, or bound to the First World through an ancestor's legacy. Your birth caught the attention of a marraine, and her powers and presence have influenced your life since birth. That influence might be benevolent, coming in the form of protective magic and uncanny good luck. Or it might be a malevolent sort of protection, hurting those around you, with expectations of servitude or sacrifice in your future.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Occultism skill and the Astrology Lore skill. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Invoke Blessing] reaction.
